pages.title: Creating Opportunity & Lowering Costs - Whitehouse for Senate
pages.text:
## Creating Opportunity & Lowering Costs
America’s economy needs to work for the middle class. The American Dream rests on the promise that every child, regardless of the zip code where they were born, can get a first-rate education and prosper in a career of their choice. That’s why I’ve been focused on improving our public schools, making higher education more affordable by increasing Pell Grants, and reducing the student debt burden on graduates who dedicated their careers to serving others. I’ve been a strong advocate for our local manufacturing industry, and I’ve delivered hundreds of millions of dollars in direct job-creating investments to Rhode Island communities.
While big corporations post record profits, many Rhode Islanders still struggle to make ends meet and worry about their children’s opportunities. I’m fighting to restore fairness to the tax code, protect unions, bring homeownership within reach, and make sure women are paid fairly. When Big Oil’s price gouging started getting out of control, I wrote a bill to claw back excess fossil fuel profits for consumers.

pages.title: Protecting Social Security & Medicare - Whitehouse for Senate
pages.text:
## Protecting Social Security & Medicare
Protecting Social Security and Medicare is so important to me that I co-founded a Senate caucus solely focused on defending Social Security – and now we’re working to expand benefits. I’ve introduced legislation to protect the solvency of Social Security and Medicare as far as the eye can see, simply by making the nation’s highest earners contribute their fair share.
Republicans have put Social Security and Medicare in their crosshairs for years. Let me be clear: I will fight with every available tool any attempt to roll back, slim down, or push further out of reach the Social Security and Medicare benefits that seniors have earned and paid for over a lifetime of hard work. I know how much Rhode Island seniors and their loved ones rely on these programs for their financial security. I am determined to remove any doubt in Rhode Islanders’ hearts about the security of these programs, so they can check that worry off their family’s list of concerns.

pages.title: Improving Health Care & Fighting the Opioid Epidemic - Whitehouse for Senate
pages.text:
## Improving Health Care & Fighting the Opioid Epidemic
In the wealthiest country in the world, every single Rhode Islander should be able to get high-quality health care at a price they can afford. From introducing the public insurance option during the Affordable Care Act debate to delivering funding to keep our state’s health care system afloat during the pandemic, I have a long track record of work to lower health care costs and improve the quality of care.
Our Inflation Reduction Act capped the price of insulin at $35 for seniors, and allowed Medicare to negotiate prescription drug prices for the first time ever. I will defend the Affordable Care Act and the Inflation Reduction Act from Republican attempts to take us back to the bad old days when people could be denied coverage for pre-existing conditions and seniors had to ration their insulin to keep food on the table.
I’ve been on a mission to help end the opioid addiction crisis that has afflicted so many families from every walk of life, and to help more Rhode Islanders succeed on the long, noble road of recovery. My bipartisan Comprehensive Addiction and Recovery Act is the most far-reaching and effective law ever passed to address addiction in America. That law is hard at work in Rhode Island, helping save lives by supporting new partnerships between law enforcement and behavioral health, making fire stations safe places to seek help for addiction, and supplying addiction medication and overdose prevention kits.

pages.title: Defending Reproductive Freedom - Whitehouse for Senate
pages.text:
## Defending Reproductive Freedom
When the right-wing justices on the Supreme Court followed the urging of far-right billionaires and overturned Roe v. Wade, it was a massive, life-altering setback for millions of women. I support codifying Roe into federal law to reverse the damage this captured Supreme Court has done to women’s freedoms. With Republicans seeking a nationwide abortion ban – even in Rhode Island – and threatening access to IVF, I will continue defending women’s rights to make their own family planning decisions and determine the course of their own lives.

pages.title: Upgrading Infrastructure - Whitehouse for Senate
pages.text:
## Upgrading Infrastructure
This year, $300 million was at work in Rhode Island on projects funded by the INFRA Program I championed through the Environment and Public Works Committee: four massive job-creating projects to upgrade the Pell Bridge, Route 146, the Providence Viaduct, and connections to Quonset Business Park. I had a hand in developing the landmark Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, which will deliver over $2 billion in investments to rebuild Rhode Island’s highways and bridges, replace lead pipes, improve drinking water and wastewater systems, boost coastal resiliency, and build EV charging infrastructure, among many other upgrades. Included in that law was a program I helped create to protect key infrastructure from climate change – a program already at work protecting our historic Mount Hope Bridge.

pages.title: Fighting Climate Change - Whitehouse for Senate
pages.text:
## Fighting Climate Change
We see firsthand what increasingly extreme storms and rising sea levels mean for our coastal economy and way of life in the Ocean State. Rhode Island’s own Coastal Resources Management Council has begun to redraw Rhode Island’s map for what those rising seas will do. I regularly battle the fossil fuel industry, so we can hasten America’s transition to a clean energy economy and leave this planet a better, safer place for our children and grandchildren.
The Inflation Reduction Act was a major step toward climate safety, and I shaped many of the clean energy provisions of the law – provisions that will save Rhode Islanders money and create jobs. I founded the bipartisan Senate Oceans Caucus to protect natural resources like Narragansett Bay, and I created a national coastal fund to help communities near the ocean address the unique challenges facing coastal infrastructure.
I’ve authored legislation to put a price on carbon pollution, reduce the emissions that drive climate change, and return the money back to the American people. Democrats and Republicans serious about tackling climate change agree that a system like the one I’ve proposed is our best bet for a path to a safe climate and healthy ocean.

pages.title: Standing Up to Special Interests - Whitehouse for Senate
pages.text:
## Standing Up to Special Interests
The American people are fed up with dark money influence campaigns that allow billionaires and big corporations to blockade progress on essential needs like solving climate change, enacting commonsense gun safety laws, and restoring women’s reproductive freedom. We need to root out special interest influence from our government and our courts, and restore power to ordinary Americans. I’m leading the charge in the Senate for disclosure laws that would undo the disastrous Citizens United decision and prevent billionaires from anonymously pulling the strings of government from the shadows.
